2609.35427.title: LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents
2609.35427.paper_summary: Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat. Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task. Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others. In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency. To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.
2609.35427.paper_summary_zh: 現代的 LLM 越來越能夠作為自主代理，但它們遵循順序互動循環：閱讀、思考、回覆或調用工具，然後重複。許多現實世界的應用案例並不是順序的：語音助手、具身代理和監控系統在思考或執行其他任務時接收新的輸入。現代 LLM 通過專門的架構來解決這一問題，以進行語音互動和視頻流，為機器人控制提供 VLA，為 API 使用提供異步工具調用等。在這項工作中，我們從不同的異步任務推廣到一般的異步代理，這些代理可以適應不同類型的並發。為了實現這一目標，我們開發了一個異步 LLM 框架，讓用戶（或代理本身）定義具有重疊記憶狀態的推理協程。我們展示了 Qwen 3.x 模型能夠進行異步操作，以理解流媒體視頻、視頻遊戲和監控，而無需特定任務的訓練。
